en.bilal-muhammad: Zakat is upon nine things: upon wheat, barley, dates, raisins, camels, cattle, sheep, gold and silver,
and the Messenger of Allah (s) pardoned what was apart from that.
It is not permissible to pay the zakat to anyone other than the people of walaya.
From the people of walaya it is not permissible to give to one’s parents, one’s child, one’s husband, one’s wife, one’s slave and anyone for whose expense the man is obliged.
